metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in Afghanistan increase in February 2018 compared to February 2017?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Does the land surface temperature in Afghanistan increase in February 2018 compared to February 2017?" I need to: 1. Define Afghanistan geometry. 2. Get land surface temperature (LST) data for February 2017 and February 2018. 3. Use appropriate data source: MODIS Terra LST (MOD11A1) is good for this. 4. Process: - Filter by date and location. - Mask clouds/quality issues using QC band. - Compute mean LST for each period over Afghanistan. 5. Check for no data (C1), no valid pixels (C2), or invalid results (C3). 6. Compare 2018 vs 2017: if 2018 > 2017, answer A (Yes), else B (No). Data considerations: - Use MODIS/006/MOD11A1 (Terra LST daily, 1km). - LST_Day_1km band is in Kelvin, scaled by 0.02. Convert to Celsius: (LST * 0.02) - 273.15. - QC_Day band: bits 0-1 indicate quality. Keep only good quality (0) and acceptable (1). - Use mean reducer over region with scale 1000. - Handle no data: if collection size = 0, try MODIS Aqua (MYD11A1) as fallback. - Validate LST range: reasonable for Afghanistan in February (likely between -20°C and 30°C). Output: concise stats and final tag. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Get Afghanistan boundary from LSIB 2017 const afg = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Afghanistan')); const region = afg.geometry(); // Date ranges for February const feb2017 = ee.DateRange('2017-02-01', '2017-02-28'); const feb2018 = ee.DateRange('2018-02-01', '2018-02-28'); // Function to get and process LST for a date range function getLST(dateRange, product) { let col = ee.ImageCollection(product) .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(dateRange.start(), dateRange.end()); // Map to convert LST to Celsius and mask poor quality col = col.map(function(img) { // Get QC band and extract bits 0-1 (LST quality) const qc = img.select('QC_Day'); const quality = qc.bitwiseAnd(3); // bits 0-1 const mask = quality.lt(2); // 0=good, 1=acceptable, 2/3=bad // Convert LST from Kelvin to Celsius: scale 0.02, offset -273.15 const lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km') .multiply(0.02) .subtract(273.15) .updateMask(mask) .rename('LST_C'); return lst.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']); }); // Mean composite for the period const meanImg = col.mean().clip(region); return {collection: col, image: meanImg}; } // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Try MODIS Terra first, fallback to Aqua if no data function tryProducts(dateRange, year) { let result = getLST(dateRange, 'MODIS/006/MOD11A1'); let colSize = result.collection.size().getInfo(); let productName = 'Terra'; if (colSize === 0) { result = getLST(dateRange, 'MODIS/006/MYD11A1'); colSize = result.collection.size().getInfo(); productName = 'Aqua'; } console.log(`${year} Images: ${colSize} (Product: ${productName})`); if (colSize === 0) { return null; } return result.image; } const img2017 = tryProducts(feb2017, '2017'); const img2018 = tryProducts(feb2018, '2018'); // Check for empty collections (C1) if (!img2017 || !img2018) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - get pixel counts and mean LST function computeStats(img, label) { const stats = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); const mean = stats.get('LST_C').getInfo(); const count = stats.get('LST_C_count').getInfo(); console.log(`${label} - Mean LST: ${mean !== null ? mean.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C, Valid Pixels: ${count}`); return {mean, count}; } const stats2017 = computeStats(img2017, '2017'); const stats2018 = computeStats(img2018, '2018'); // Check for no valid pixels (C2) if (stats2017.count === 0 || stats2018.count === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer // Check for invalid values (C3) if (stats2017.mean === null || stats2018.mean === null || isNaN(stats2017.mean) || isNaN(stats2018.mean)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Reasonable LST range check for Afghanistan in February if (stats2017.mean < -50 || stats2017.mean > 50 || stats2018.mean < -50 || stats2018.mean > 50) { console.log('Warning: LST out of expected range.'); } // Determine answer const increase = stats2018.mean > stats2017.mean; console.log(`Change: ${stats2018.mean - stats2017.mean:.2f}°C`); if (increase) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
